target_customer: Spanish-speaking individuals and couples in Mexico seeking online therapy, plus employers through a corporate program
problem: Access to affordable, stigma-free therapy in Spanish was limited; the idea came from a founder's own years of delay before seeking help for depression.
business_model: Direct-to-consumer per-session fees plus B2B employee mental health program

founders.name: Juan Daniel Velez Santiago
education: International Business (Negocios Internacionales), per Platzi article
founders.background_notes: Platzi says the idea came from his own experience with depression and therapy; the founders taught themselves to program.

founders.name: Eduardo Velez Santiago
founders.background_notes: Brother of Daniel; YC page lists him as founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Video sessions, scheduling and psychologist matching are standard marketplace engineering; the founders taught themselves to build it.

defensibility.rationale: A local supply of psychologists and reviews helps, but marketplaces for therapy are easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed it by 2026; the site shows continued operation with claims of 400 psychologists and 300,000 sessions (company claim).

market_need_then: The Platzi article describes social stigma and poor access to therapy in Mexico and the company reported 30% monthly growth in 2018; the pandemic from 2020 increased online care demand.

branding.brand_signature: First appointment guarantee to switch psychologists at no cost
branding.community_and_virality: Won Platzi DemoDay 2018 per Platzi; a 2023 Expansion profile on the founder's story; site cites 13,866 reviews (company claim).

brand_strength.rationale: Clear descriptive coinage in its market with founder-story press, but little evidence of brand pull beyond the product.

outcome_analysis: Terapify is still operating in Mexico, driven by a founder-led story of personal need, and the company claims hundreds of psychologists and over 300,000 sessions. Funding figures conflict across aggregators, from about $190K to over $1M, so the capital story is unclear. The company has stayed focused on the Spanish-speaking market with a B2B offering.
notes: Funding sources are aggregators only (Seedtable, PitchBook, CB Insights, Contxto) with totals of $190K, $400K, $435K and over $1M; no primary announcement opened, so amount is null and the round is partial. Founding year conflicts (2016, 2018, 2019). Competitor search found only undated directory listings (Telavita, Terapi, Calmerry), none with a source dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Eduardo's role as CTO appears only in a Crunchbase snippet and is not used.
